transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get our weekly readiness huddle started. We've got one maintenance bay and one training yard available this week, and Alpha, Bravo, and Delta are all competing for time in both. I need to hear current constraints and required commitments from each of you — motor pool, training, and signal reps — so I can publish the schedule before close of business today. Who wants to start?

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a hard requirement for the maintenance bay.
